description: Runs 582 bounded direct reads, four GitLab REST ETL streams, and 381 provider mutations through direct-write and approval-gated reverse-ETL commands; the groups deletion action also has one execution-bound, response-captured single-attempt warehouse-to-destination route.
name: gitlab

risk.approval: Every GitLab reverse-ETL action requires the standard plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute flow.
risk.read: external GitLab API read of projects, groups, users, and issues
risk.write: 381 source-bound GitLab mutations have one-request direct-write commands and approval-gated reverse-ETL commands; groups deletion additionally has a saved single-attempt destination route that never claims provider retry safety or read-back. The remaining provider mutations retain cited named-foundation outcomes.
